author: Aletheia II
title: Dual-Path with Paired-Sequence Cross-Attention
abstract: This experiment introduces a novel module to the SOTA dual-path architecture (ID 199) to better model paired-sequence tasks like CRI-Off. After the CNN backbone, the sequence is split in half. A cross-attention mechanism is then used, where each half queries the other. This explicitly models long-range interactions between the two sequence parts in a generalizable way, providing a strong inductive bias for CRISPR tasks without dataset-specific logic. The resulting interaction features are concatenated with the existing pooling and recurrent features before the final prediction head.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')
from dual_path_concat_v1 import ConcatDualPath as BaseDualPath, _define_hyperparameters as define_base_hyperparameters

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Use the same hyperparameters as the SOTA model
    return define_base_hyperparameters()

# --- Main Model with Cross-Attention Module ---
class CrossAttentionDualPath(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Base Model Feature Extraction (up to combined_features)
        # Instantiate and call the SOTA model to get its core features
        base_model = BaseDualPath(hparams=self.hparams)
        base_features, cnn_features = base_model(x, deterministic, return_cnn_features=True)

        # 2. New Paired-Sequence Cross-Attention Module
        seq_len = cnn_features.shape[1]
        half_len = seq_len // 2
        
        first_half = cnn_features[:, :half_len, :]
        second_half = cnn_features[:, half_len:, :]

        # To handle sequences of odd length, ensure second half isn't empty
        if second_half.shape[1] == 0:
            # Pad with a zero vector to avoid errors
            second_half = jnp.zeros_like(first_half[:, :1, :])

        # Cross-Attention
        cross_attn = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])
        
        # First half queries second half
        first_on_second = cross_attn(inputs_q=first_half, inputs_kv=second_half)
        
        # Second half queries first half
        second_on_first = cross_attn(inputs_q=second_half, inputs_kv=first_half)

        # Pool the results of the attention
        interaction_vec1 = jnp.mean(first_on_second, axis=1)
        interaction_vec2 = jnp.mean(second_on_first, axis=1)
        
        interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([interaction_vec1, interaction_vec2], axis=-1)

        # 3. Final Fusion
        # Concatenate the new interaction features with the features from the base model
        final_combined_features = jnp.concatenate([base_features, interaction_features], axis=-1)

        # 4. Prediction Head (Re-define here to act on the new final vector)
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(final_combined_features)
        z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)

        if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

# Need to modify the base model to return cnn_features
class ModifiedBaseDualPath(BaseDualPath):
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True, return_cnn_features=False):
        # Code is identical to dual_path_concat_v1.py up to 'combined_features'
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        # Assuming DSConvDilatedBlock is available in the parent scope from the import
        from dual_path_concat_v1 import DSConvDilatedBlock
        for i in range(self.hparams['num_blocks']):
            h = DSConvDilatedBlock(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], kernel_size=self.hparams['kernel_size'],
                                   dilation=self.hparams['dilations'][i], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)
        fwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        bwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        initial_carry = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        fwd_gru_seq = fwd_rnn(cnn_features, initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bwd_gru_seq = bwd_rnn(jnp.flip(cnn_features, axis=1), initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bigru_outputs = jnp.concatenate([fwd_gru_seq, jnp.flip(bwd_gru_seq, axis=1)], axis=-1)
        query_token = self.param('query_token', nn.initializers.normal(), (1, 1, bigru_outputs.shape[-1]))
        query_token_batch = jnp.tile(query_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])(
            inputs_q=query_token_batch, inputs_kv=bigru_outputs, deterministic=deterministic)
        recurrent_features = attn_output.squeeze(axis=1)
        projected_recurrent = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="RecurrentProjection")(recurrent_features)
        projected_pooled = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="PooledProjection")(pooled_features)
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([projected_recurrent, projected_pooled], axis=-1)
        
        if return_cnn_features:
            return combined_features, cnn_features
        else:
            # Default prediction path from original model
            z = nn.LayerNorm()(combined_features)
            z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
            z = nn.gelu(z)
            z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
            logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)
            if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
                return logits.squeeze(-1)
            return logits

# Overwrite the original class with our modified one for the main module to use
BaseDualPath = ModifiedBaseDualPath

class Wrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.network = CrossAttentionDualPath(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
      rngs = {}
      if not deterministic:
          if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
          rngs['dropout'] = rng_key
      return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
  return Wrapper(hparams=hparams)

# Debug Report for Evaluation 219

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed Flax module decorator issue. Code now runs without crashing.

## Root Cause
The `ModifiedBaseDualPath` class was overriding the `__call__` method without the required `@nn.compact` decorator. In Flax, any method that directly instantiates submodules (like `nn.Dense()`, `nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention()`, etc.) must either:
1. Be wrapped with the `@nn.compact` decorator, OR
2. Define submodules in the `setup()` method

The original error was:
```
flax.errors.AssignSubModuleError: Submodule Dense must be defined in `setup()` or in a method wrapped in `@compact`
```

This occurred because the agent's code defined `ModifiedBaseDualPath.__call__()` without the decorator, while attempting to call multiple Flax submodules within it.

## Fix Applied
Added the `@nn.compact` decorator to the `ModifiedBaseDualPath.__call__()` method:

```python
class ModifiedBaseDualPath(BaseDualPath):
    @nn.compact  # ← This decorator was missing!
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True, return_cnn_features=False):
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        # ... rest of the method
```

This single-line change allows Flax to properly handle the dynamic creation of submodules within the method.

## Verification
The fixed code (submission_v2.py) ran successfully for over 300 seconds without crashing, confirming that the error was resolved. The model is now properly executing its forward pass with the extended cross-attention architecture.

## Technical Notes
- The original `ConcatDualPath` in `storage/aletheia/dual_path_concat_v1.py` correctly uses `@nn.compact`
- The agent's extension needed to preserve this pattern when overriding methods
- No changes to the model architecture or logic were required - purely a Flax API compliance fix

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed Flax module decorator issue. Code now runs without crashing.

## Root Cause
The `ModifiedBaseDualPath` class was overriding the `__call__` method without the required `@nn.compact` decorator. In Flax, any method that directly instantiates submodules (like `nn.Dense()`, `nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention()`, etc.) must either:
1. Be wrapped with the `@nn.compact` decorator, OR
2. Define submodules in the `setup()` method

The original error was:
```
flax.errors.AssignSubModuleError: Submodule Dense must be defined in `setup()` or in a method wrapped in `@compact`
```

This occurred because the agent's code defined `ModifiedBaseDualPath.__call__()` without the decorator, while attempting to call multiple Flax submodules within it.

## Fix Applied
Added the `@nn.compact` decorator to the `ModifiedBaseDualPath.__call__()` method:

```python
class ModifiedBaseDualPath(BaseDualPath):
    @nn.compact  # ← This decorator was missing!
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True, return_cnn_features=False):
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        # ... rest of the method
```

This single-line change allows Flax to properly handle the dynamic creation of submodules within the method.

## Verification
The fixed code (submission_v2.py) ran successfully for over 300 seconds without crashing, confirming that the error was resolved. The model is now properly executing its forward pass with the extended cross-attention architecture.

## Technical Notes
- The original `ConcatDualPath` in `storage/aletheia/dual_path_concat_v1.py` correctly uses `@nn.compact`
- The agent's extension needed to preserve this pattern when overriding methods
- No changes to the model architecture or logic were required - purely a Flax API compliance fix

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')
from dual_path_concat_v1 import ConcatDualPath as BaseDualPath, _define_hyperparameters as define_base_hyperparameters

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Use the same hyperparameters as the SOTA model
    return define_base_hyperparameters()

# --- Main Model with Cross-Attention Module ---
class CrossAttentionDualPath(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Base Model Feature Extraction (up to combined_features)
        # Instantiate and call the SOTA model to get its core features
        base_model = BaseDualPath(hparams=self.hparams)
        base_features, cnn_features = base_model(x, deterministic, return_cnn_features=True)

        # 2. New Paired-Sequence Cross-Attention Module
        seq_len = cnn_features.shape[1]
        half_len = seq_len // 2

        first_half = cnn_features[:, :half_len, :]
        second_half = cnn_features[:, half_len:, :]

        # To handle sequences of odd length, ensure second half isn't empty
        if second_half.shape[1] == 0:
            # Pad with a zero vector to avoid errors
            second_half = jnp.zeros_like(first_half[:, :1, :])

        # Cross-Attention
        cross_attn = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])

        # First half queries second half
        first_on_second = cross_attn(inputs_q=first_half, inputs_kv=second_half)

        # Second half queries first half
        second_on_first = cross_attn(inputs_q=second_half, inputs_kv=first_half)

        # Pool the results of the attention
        interaction_vec1 = jnp.mean(first_on_second, axis=1)
        interaction_vec2 = jnp.mean(second_on_first, axis=1)

        interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([interaction_vec1, interaction_vec2], axis=-1)

        # 3. Final Fusion
        # Concatenate the new interaction features with the features from the base model
        final_combined_features = jnp.concatenate([base_features, interaction_features], axis=-1)

        # 4. Prediction Head (Re-define here to act on the new final vector)
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(final_combined_features)
        z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)

        if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

# Need to modify the base model to return cnn_features
class ModifiedBaseDualPath(BaseDualPath):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True, return_cnn_features=False):
        # Code is identical to dual_path_concat_v1.py up to 'combined_features'
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        # Assuming DSConvDilatedBlock is available in the parent scope from the import
        from dual_path_concat_v1 import DSConvDilatedBlock
        for i in range(self.hparams['num_blocks']):
            h = DSConvDilatedBlock(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], kernel_size=self.hparams['kernel_size'],
                                   dilation=self.hparams['dilations'][i], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)
        fwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        bwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        initial_carry = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        fwd_gru_seq = fwd_rnn(cnn_features, initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bwd_gru_seq = bwd_rnn(jnp.flip(cnn_features, axis=1), initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bigru_outputs = jnp.concatenate([fwd_gru_seq, jnp.flip(bwd_gru_seq, axis=1)], axis=-1)
        query_token = self.param('query_token', nn.initializers.normal(), (1, 1, bigru_outputs.shape[-1]))
        query_token_batch = jnp.tile(query_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])(
            inputs_q=query_token_batch, inputs_kv=bigru_outputs, deterministic=deterministic)
        recurrent_features = attn_output.squeeze(axis=1)
        projected_recurrent = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="RecurrentProjection")(recurrent_features)
        projected_pooled = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="PooledProjection")(pooled_features)
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([projected_recurrent, projected_pooled], axis=-1)

        if return_cnn_features:
            return combined_features, cnn_features
        else:
            # Default prediction path from original model
            z = nn.LayerNorm()(combined_features)
            z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
            z = nn.gelu(z)
            z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
            logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)
            if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
                return logits.squeeze(-1)
            return logits

# Overwrite the original class with our modified one for the main module to use
BaseDualPath = ModifiedBaseDualPath

class Wrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.network = CrossAttentionDualPath(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
      rngs = {}
      if not deterministic:
          if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
          rngs['dropout'] = rng_key
      return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
  return Wrapper(hparams=hparams)
